$doc: CC-ORTHO-SWEEP-ALL: generator rules and seed pairs handed to CC-SENSE-CUE (it owns the table, its status and the read API). Nothing here changes grading. kind true = identical sound in this voice; accent = differs for some speakers or in some voices, never accepted as a homophone.
status: missing: no generator yet (SENSE-CUE builds key_pt); rules and seeds staged

rules.description: s, ss, ç, c, sc, x, z in sibilant positions
ch and x as the sh sound
unstressed e/i and o/u in the Brazilian voice; kept accent until the loopback measures it
final l as a w sound (mal/mau) in the Brazilian voice
